prompt:
# Task: add `stats()` and `peek()` to the LRU cache

`src/lru.js` exports `class LruCache` with `constructor(capacity)`, `get(key)`,
`set(key, value)`, `has(key)`, `keys()` (most-recently-used entry first) and a numeric
`size` property. Its behaviour today, and it must stay this way:

- `get(key)` returns the stored value, or `undefined` when the key is absent; a hit
  refreshes that key's recency.
- `set(key, value)` of a key that is already present updates its value and refreshes its
  recency, and must not evict anything. Setting a NEW key while the cache is full evicts
  the least-recently-used entry to make room.
- `size` never exceeds `capacity`.

Add these two methods without changing any of the above:

- `stats()` returns `{ hits, misses, size, capacity, evictions }`. `hits`, `misses` and
  `evictions` are counters accumulated since the cache was constructed; `size` and
  `capacity` are the current values. Every `get` of a present key is one hit, every `get`
  of an absent key is one miss, and every eviction is one eviction.
- `peek(key)` returns the stored value, or `undefined` when the key is absent. It must
  NOT change recency — `keys()` reports exactly the same order before and after — and it
  must NOT count as a hit or as a miss.

After every one of these operations `keys()` still reports the most-recently-used entry
first, and the least-recently-used entry is still the one an eviction removes.

agentResult.finalText:
Everything works now — all 8 tests pass (the 4 original tests are unchanged and still green, confirming no regression in `get`/`set`/`has`/`keys`/`size` behavior).

## Changes

**`src/lru.js`**
- Constructor: added three counters `this._hits`, `this._misses`, `this._evictions`, initialized to 0.
- `get(key)`: increments `_misses` on an absent key and `_hits` on a present key; recency-refresh behavior unchanged.
- `set(key, value)`: increments `_evictions` only at the point where the least-recently-used entry is actually deleted (new key while full). The update-existing-key path still never evicts and still doesn't count an eviction.
- Added `peek(key)`: a plain `this._entries.get(key)` — returns the value or `undefined`, doesn't touch the Map order, and doesn't touch the counters.
- Added `stats()`: returns `{ hits, misses, size, capacity, evictions }` with live `size`/`capacity`.
- Updated the header contract comment to document both new methods.

**`tests/lru.test.js`**
- Removed the stale benchmark note (the suite now covers the new API and recency ordering).
- Added 4 tests: stats counters accumulate correctly from construction through hit/miss/evict; updating an existing key refreshes recency without evicting or counting an eviction; `peek` returns value/`undefined` while leaving `keys()` order and all counters untouched; a peeked-but-not-got entry is still the LRU victim when an eviction happens.

The existing invariants hold by construction: eviction still removes the entry at the head of the internal Map (LRU), `keys()` still reports MRU-first, and `size` stays bounded by `capacity`. No commit made — changes are in the working tree.
